summary: The change implements String.prototype.isWellFormed as specified. It runs RequireObjectCoercible and then ToString on the this value, propagating errors with `?`, and performs ToString once. The IsStringWellFormedUnicode helper is a faithful loop over UTF-16 units: a high surrogate followed by a low surrogate is skipped as a pair, and any other lone high or low surrogate returns false. Step comments are kept in place. No special-casing, hardcoded values, swallowed errors or out-of-scope edits were found. The gate report shows build and clippy OK, 8 new passing test262 tests and no regressions.
